nodes.label: CSCI 3230U AI Use Policy
nodes.rationale: Lets students learn to use AI coding tools like professionals while keeping early learning honest and putting no one at a disadvantage.

nodes.label: AI Documentation Requirement
nodes.rationale: AI that produces submitted work must be recorded in AI-USAGE.md with the exact prompt, before commit; documenting honestly is a normal professional habit and the safe choice against academic-misconduct charges.

nodes.label: AI-Free Milestones 1-2
nodes.rationale: Milestones 1-2 (weeks 3, 6) must be written without AI generating code so the early learning stays honest; milestones 3-4 (week 10, final exam week) may use AI.

nodes.label: Free Models Only Rule
nodes.rationale: Only AI tools without a paid plan may be used because no one should need to spend money for the course; the model used cannot be verified, but undocumented AI code is an integrity violation.

nodes.label: Encouraged AI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Do it yourself first so you learn, then delegate repetitive or boilerplate work, and always review and verify - you own every line you submit and may be asked to explain any part of the project.

nodes.label: What Counts as AI-Generated
nodes.rationale: Documented: AI-written or AI-refactored submitted code, AI-generated CSS/markup, non-trivial autocomplete blocks. Not regulated: explanations, error-message help, library suggestions, single-token completions.
